title: Integrable functions, dominated convergence and null sets
summary: L^1(μ) and the integral of real and complex functions; linearity and |∫ f| ≤ ∫ |f|; the dominated convergence theorem via Fatou; sets of measure zero, almost-everywhere equality, completion of a measure space; the Riemann integral compared with the Lebesgue integral (Riemann integrable iff continuous almost everywhere).

preparation.description: Read lecture 5 (5 PDF pages): L^1, complex integrals, linearity, |∫ f| ≤ ∫ |f|, the dominated convergence theorem, sets of measure zero, completion.
Read lecture 3, PDF page 1: measure-zero subsets of R and Theorem 0.1 (Riemann integrable iff continuous almost everywhere), stated without proof in the notes.
